customerHome.faqQ1: What is Trove and who is it designed for?
customerHome.faqA1: Trove is a next-generation dating technology platform specifically designed for couples in Vietnam and beyond. Unlike traditional restaurant-finding apps, Trove wraps the entire experience around the couple's journey together — from brainstorming date ideas and choosing the right venue, to building a detailed schedule and preserving beautiful memories. The comprehensive feature ecosystem includes: smart venue search with multi-filters (fine dining, romantic cafes, cinemas, activities), a lucky spin wheel that instantly solves the eternal 'Where should we go tonight?' debate, and an AI-powered auto-scheduler that maps out hour-by-hour itineraries shareable directly with your partner. Trove is perfect for every couple — from newly dating pairs still discovering each other, to long-term couples wanting to inject new excitement into their relationship.
customerHome.faqQ2: Can non-registered guest users access the application?
customerHome.faqA2: Absolutely! Guest users can freely browse the Trove homepage to explore a rich catalog of trending public dining, entertainment, and cafe venues, view real community ratings and photo reviews, plus check real-time showtimes at major cinemas nationwide. However, to unlock 100% of Trove's power with fully personalized tools — saving private favorites lists, spinning the lucky destination wheel, creating custom date itineraries, sharing interactive plans with your significant other, posting community reviews, and receiving personalized venue recommendations — all you need is 30 seconds to register a completely free member account. No credit card required, no long-term commitment.
customerHome.faqQ3: How do Gold and Diamond packages differ? Is upgrading worth it?
customerHome.faqA3: The GOLD membership package (just 59,000 VND/month) is perfect for couples who love to explore: unlimited daily venue review posts with no daily cap, plus full access to the community-curated Secret Spots list — quiet, romantic hidden cafes and rendezvous corners that only VIP members know about. The DIAMOND membership package (119,000 VND/month) is for those who demand the absolute premium experience: all Gold benefits included, plus exclusive access to rare Diamond Exclusive coordinates (limited-access venues with million-dollar views that require advance booking), an anonymous posting mode to share reviews without revealing your identity, and a sparkling Diamond Badge displayed next to your username on all posts and comments. Both packages are fully month-to-month with no long-term contracts — cancel anytime with no fees.
customerHome.faqQ4: Which cities and regions does Trove currently cover?
customerHome.faqA4: Trove has built rich venue databases and detailed city guides across 6 of Vietnam's leading tourism and economic hubs: Hanoi (Old Quarter, Tay Ho, Cau Giay districts), Ho Chi Minh City (Districts 1, 3, Phu Nhuan, Thu Duc), Da Nang (Hai Chau, Son Tra, Ngu Hanh Son), Nha Trang (downtown, beaches, resort areas), Da Lat (waterfall zones, night market, scenic cafes), and Can Tho (floating market, eco-tourism). Our dedicated moderation team and active local community members continuously verify addresses, update photos, and approve hundreds of new quality dining and entertainment venues each week to keep information accurate and fresh. On our development roadmap, we will expand coverage to Hue, Hoi An, Phu Quoc, and Vung Tau by the end of 2025.
customerHome.faqQ5: Can I submit my own business or suggest new venues to the platform?
customerHome.faqA5: Yes, you absolutely can — and Trove strongly encourages it! Trove is built on a community-contribution model where any registered member has the right to suggest new and exciting spots to the shared map. Simply tap the 'Suggest Venue' button on the map interface, fill in the required details: venue name, precise street address, reference price range, high-quality real photos, and a short description. Once submitted, the Trove admin team will review and verify your submission within 24 working hours. Upon approval, your venue goes live to the entire Trove community and you earn member points toward your account level. This is also the ideal free channel for local cafe owners, restaurant managers, and entertainment venues to showcase their brand and attract the community of millions of couples actively using Trove.
customerHome.faqQ6: How does Trove handle and protect my personal data and date history?
customerHome.faqA6: Trove is fully committed to protecting all of your personal information and private date plans to the highest international security standards. All data is encrypted end-to-end using industry-standard SSL/TLS 256-bit encryption protocols and stored on multi-layered protected server infrastructure. GPS location data is only requested temporarily within your browser session when you search for nearby venues — your location history is never stored on our servers or sold to any third party. Your date itineraries, personal messages, and saved favorites remain completely private and are only visible when you actively choose to share them. With the anonymous posting feature (Diamond members only), you can even share venue experiences and date reviews without ever revealing your real identity. Trove has a strict no data-selling policy — your personal information will never be traded or used for commercial advertising purposes without your explicit consent.
